notes: «قد روي عن ابن عمر، عن عمر، عن النبي» names other transmitters for the same ghusl ruling: a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
«حدثنا بذلك» after the saying is a second isnad carrying the same saying: its own group; it stops at al-Zuhri as written (a shorter chain, the convention of this book)
«أبيه» is a relation (rule 7); «قال أبو عيسى» and the grading words are the compiler's own comment; «بينما عمر بن الخطاب يخطب» is the story's scene
